steps.what: Review inputs and prepare an assessment

loop.check: a person checks evidence and exceptions before use
loop.stop: stop on missing evidence, conflicting records, or low confidence; send to the role holder
loop.why_not_simpler: The task needs reading and judgement across unstructured records.

steps.what: Decide the outcome and record it

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} flow collects required fields and source records, then produces a structured assessment for the role holder. The role holder makes the outcome decision and the flow writes the versioned record to {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Records were scattered and each assessment had to be read from scratch.
tasks.enabler_now: A workflow can require fields and a bounded loop can structure untrusted documents.
tasks.still_hard: Missing evidence, exceptions, and accountable decisions still need a person.
tasks.human_edge: The role holder weighs context, accountability, and the impact on people.

ambition.what: Review the exception queue each working day.

tasks.altitude: The role holder spends less time assembling records and more time resolving exceptions and improving decision rules.

reach.learn: Read workflow measures and test rule changes.

evidence.claim: A bounded document-review loop with a human decision is plausible from model knowledge.

assumptions: The workflow boundary starts with a task request and ends with a versioned outcome record.
Structured input fields are task identifier, request date, source record version, status, owner, and decision reason; the requesting team produces them.
Missing fields are entered manually; unstructured documents use bounded extraction and are routed to the role holder when extraction fails.
Native system configuration is tested before custom code.
The numerical upkeep allowance covers rule review and exception tuning once the flow is live.
unknowns: Which system is the record of truth and which fields it exposes.
The exception rate, decision authority, and applicable national rules.
research_questions: What share of cases has complete source records?
Which decisions may be prepared but not automated?

already_counted.description: Review of prepared assessment and exceptions

incremental.description: Review workflow rules and recurring exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes incomplete records and frequent exceptions; two hours of upkeep per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
